text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein's speech on army day captures world-wide attention.
- Tunisian president calls for the lifting of sanctions on Iraq.
- Iraqi authorities capture killers of Jordanian driver.
- Iraqi police to mark founding anniversary.
- Trade ministry hands out foodstuffs to low income groups at a discount.
- Defence minister congratulates Saddam on army day.
- Qatari newspaper calls on Arabs to cooperate with Iraq.
- Commentaries lambast Turkey and Washington on anti-Iraq. policies
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Great number of army deserters in Iraqi Kurdistan return to national fold.
- Jordanians form human shield to prevent the holding of an Israeli trade exhbition in Amman.
